items.title: Staggered age of consent to be discussed after Brand case, minister says
items.summary: A woman who alleges she was raped by the jailed comedian when she was 16 is campaigning to see relationships between 16-and 17-year-olds and adults made illegal.

items.title: Man and woman die and four arrested after police pursuit crash in Leeds
items.summary: Four people have been arrested on suspicion of causing death by dangerous driving, police say.

items.title: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
items.summary: The Ukrainian president says restrictions are still in place and making it difficult to stop Russian attacks.

items.title: Ex-Met Police inspector lied about wife's death in Barbados hotel room, BBC learns
items.summary: Warren Arter faced claims of sexually exploiting crime victims - his wife was found in a blood-stained room.

items.title: Minister backs legal right to job support for young people
items.summary: The work and pensions secretary said the level of support currently on offer was too vague.

items.title: Pope Leo rides in helicopter cockpit during Peru trip
items.summary: The Pope took to the skies before arriving in Cusco on the penultimate day of his Latin America tour.

items.title: Thousands of US flights still cancelled or delayed two days after grounding of planes nationwide
items.summary: The US transport secretary says that normal air-traffic operations may not be restored until Monday.

items.title: Trident submarine returns home after record-breaking undersea patrol
items.summary: Defence Secretary Wes Streeting was at HM Naval Base Clyde to welcome the crew after the longest deployment at sea for a British vessel.
